notes.title: Triple Take is a game of the saying “third time’s the charm” – but the third time might just cause some rage quits this time
notes.content:
Finland biggest publisher Bonus Stage Publishing (That's us, yey) today announced Triple Take: a game by FlyAway found its way to their portfolio. The game will be released in 2022. 

The demo is already available on Steam.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734250

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37611909/cf3eddeeff2922ebb1d02fc717e994d92a883a17.gif[/img]

Triple Take is a series of unexpected experiences in the form of a fast 2D precision platformer where the level evolves as you complete it! Run, wall jump, climb and swim through increasingly difficult levels in (un)vibrantly colored worlds! 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37611909/ba6e8606ffab44e3c9d11140963f44d7e722b7c8.jpg[/img]

When you start any level for the first time, it might seem to be almost too easy to beat, but the levels evolve when you play further. Every time you beat any level, the level changes somehow and you need to play it again. Three times. Triple Take. Ok, you got it. This makes completing levels… difficult. Jumps become more difficult, new threats reveal themselves, and new pathways open up! Difficult.

notes.title: The Last Soul sees the light of the day in 2022 by Bonus Stage Publishing
notes.content:
Last Soul is an action-packed shooting platformer headlining BOP, the last remaining soul on earth fighting against Cyber-Being. You play as the cute but powerful BOP and in addition to all the regular mechanics, your jetpack, shields, and bullet time pack some real punch against the evil forces trying to destroy even the last of the remaining souls.

The vast world of Last Soul is inspired by Star Wars, Tron Legacy, Mario, Sonic and Megaman, Neon Abyss, and all that can be seen in the graphics and felt in the soundtrack. The perfectly sci-fi-retro music is balanced with an equally great story. 

"I took the time to study the 'Hero with a thousand faces' (by Joseph Campbell) and set the basis for my game story. The Last Soul includes a hero which is moved to an adventure that he doesn't want; a closing partner that he needs to achieve his destiny; a powerful enemy with a basic conflict with the hero; a master that teaches the hero the truth; and many other equally important elements", tells Tony Munoz, the lead developer of WULUM, the Canadian studio behind Last Soul.

[previewyoutube=apKCFSTq4sw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

The game is soon to be launched on Kickstarter for pre-orders and early fan bonuses. The campaign is set to start in October, with pre-registration open now. There are almost 600 pre-registered fans waiting, and nearly 20,000 players in the Last Soul prologue.

The game will be launched in Q2/2022 and will come out on all major platforms. The publisher is the still fresh name from Finland, Bonus Stage Publishing. Bonus Stage has also published Sunblaze in June 2021, which is as well a game that goes well with speedrunners, just like Last Soul.

The game will be a perfect addition to their portfolio according to Sami Mikkola from Bonus Stage: "When we first saw Last Soul, the immediate reaction from all of us was 'WE NEED TO HAVE THIS'. The cuteness, retro sci-fi setting, and its unique but tough-as-nails gameplay were just immediate Yes' from us."

Last Soul is just about to open up on Kickstarter, and is already ready to be wishlisted & followed on Steam.

notes.title: New phase of LAST SOUL is on the way
notes.content:
During the last weeks, we dedicated ourselves to prepare the new features of LAST SOUL while listening to the suggestions of our fans. Now we're getting ready to present it to you.

We revisited all game elements, from the art to the mechanics and camera position. Everything needs to feel right for the levels that you already played and new challenges that you'll confront. To achieve this we're in constants communication with our fans using our social media. If you aren't part of this already, join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/TaAVqT9paB]Discord[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.wulum.com ]Subscribe to our Mail List[/url][/b] to access Alphas/Betas of the final release.

Keeping you updated on our work is one of the most important things to do for our studio. But having the opportunity to exchange ideas with you while we're developing... that's amazing. That's why you can also follow our development on [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/wulum]Twitch[/url][/b] while the creator of LAST SOUL, Tony Munoz, will refresh you about the current work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39573845/4b1a28a894a793e6bf8c89dfea7d9834b0086f69.png[/img]

During the next weeks, you'll get more information about LAST SOUL progress. And if you haven't done that already, remember to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1566040/Last_Soul/]wishlist the final version of our game here[/url][/b]. Help us spread the word. We know you love the Prologue version... but what's coming will be marvelous.

Thanks for your amazing support.

notes.title: Fans' suggestions are becoming a reality
notes.content:
During the last weeks, we designed the new PixelArt of "LAST SOUL" live on Twitch and now your suggestions are becoming part of our game.

It has always been our goal to create "LAST SOUL" listening to the feedback and requests of our followers. At every step of the development, we're promoting new content to know the thoughts from outside. It's essential for us to keep this constant communication and get feedback to confirm that what we're doing feels right. And if we have to change direction, we can always ask for ideas.

Based on your excitement of the current Art, we're moving forward with the next levels of the game. Our final goal is to have a game with a least 40 different levels. Now, the most waiting levels are on the go: Level 2 and 3. Here, BOP gets to earth looking for SUP. What will come next it's a secret that you'll discover very soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39573845/1b8d06901b302ce791e4d53e133383a838eb6d90.png[/img]

[h2]Remember to Wishlist And Follow the Final Version[/h2]
The support from our fans continues. But we still have a long path ahead of us. That's why we remember you to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1566040/Last_Soul/]Wishlist and Follow the Final Version of "LAST SOUL."[/url] Remember that this version new version is not the prologue. We're creating a totally new game that we'll be released in 2022, and we starting our growing campaign of followers from this moment.

You're part of our creation. Please, remember to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1566040/Last_Soul/]Wishlist and Follow "LAST SOUL" final release[/url].

Eight after the release of "LAST SOUL - Prologue" demo, we had more than 10.000 gamers downloading our game. For our team, it's a dream that we got to so many people around the world.

After the huge support for the Prologue, we released a new Steam Page with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1566040/Last_Soul/]final version of "LAST SOUL."[/url] We know that we have a lot to do yet, but we're confident of BOP, our Sci-Fi story, the mechanics, features, music, and art style.

Now we're asking for your support again by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1566040/Last_Soul/]Wishlist and Following "LAST SOUL"[/url] final version. This small contribution from you will make a huge difference at the moment of our release and we'll keep us working on this and future games.

We're thrilled about the future and we want to express our thanks. Don't forget to make your contributions and express your ideas on our [url=https://discord.gg/TaAVqT9paB]Discord[/url], join our [url=https://www.wulum.com]Mailing List[/url] to access Alphas and Betas, and remember to helping us spread the word.

notes.title: LAST SOUL is open to the world
notes.content:
The first version of "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1425580/Last_Soul/]Last Soul[/url]" was released on Jan 28th exclusively for our registered fans. It was a free occasion. Everybody was invited, but you need to be part of our community to receive a key to download the game.

After three amazing days of streamers trying our game, showing their laughs, and enjoying their experience, we decided to move forward with a new stage: We open our game to the entire world FREE TO PLAY.

Now we're collecting suggestions, ideas, questions, bugs, and any type of feedback to improve your gaming experience.

This week we'll start a new phase of development. We'll be looking for publishers for our game so we can boost the rest of the development for a period of an entire year. But this is not our only plan.

Get ready for what is coming. Soon, you'll be playing the new updates and new levels of our game.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/TaAVqT9paB]Discord community[/url] to suggest new ideas to improve your experience to the max.

And remember to try [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1425580/Last_Soul/]LAST SOUL[/url] now and spread the word.
